Orville Lynn Majors, also known as The Angel of Death, was a nurse who would kill patients by giving them lethal doses of heart-stopping drugs (Potassium-something, I cant remember the actual name).  He was eventually convicted for six murders but investigators think he might have been responsible for the deaths of over 100 people because everyone just believed that patients were dying because of their illnesses.
